@graph.description: A board-certified trichologist and hair loss specialist in Atlanta, Dr. Nina Ross, ND PhD, treating the root cause of hair loss with functional medicine.

acceptedAnswer.text: A trichologist is a specialist in the hair and scalp. As a board-certified trichologist and functional medicine doctor, I diagnose the type and cause of your hair loss, then treat the root driver, whether that is thyroid, iron, hormones, or stress.

mainEntity.name: What causes hair loss, and can it be reversed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most hair loss is downstream of something systemic, thyroid, iron, hormones, or stress. When we find and treat the real driver, your hair often has the conditions it needs to recover.

mainEntity.name: How is a trichologist different from a dermatologist?

acceptedAnswer.text: A dermatologist focuses on the skin and scalp surface. As a trichologist paired with functional medicine, I also test what is happening inside, the thyroid, nutrients, and hormones behind the shedding, and treat that root cause.

mainEntity.name: What lab testing do you run for hair loss?

acceptedAnswer.text: We go beyond a basic panel, thyroid, iron and ferritin, a full hormone panel, and inflammatory markers, because that is where most hair loss actually begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you work alongside my regular doctor or dermatologist?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Care here is provided alongside, not in place of, your primary, dermatology, and specialty care. We coordinate so the whole picture stays connected.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer virtual hair-loss visits or only in person in Atlanta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. See me in person at our Atlanta clinic, or virtually anywhere in Georgia. Your $99 Symptom Consultation can be booked either way.

sections.label: Hero

headings.text: A trichologist in Atlanta who finds what is really behind your hair loss.

paragraphs: If your hair is thinning, shedding, or changing and no one has explained why, you deserve a specialist who investigates the cause, not just the scalp.

I am Dr. Nina Ross, ND PhD, a board-certified trichologist and functional medicine doctor. Thinning hair is usually a signal from somewhere deeper, thyroid, iron, hormones, or stress. I run advanced labs to find which one is driving yours, here in Atlanta and virtually across Georgia, then treat the root so your hair has what it needs to recover.

imageSlots.alt: Dr. Nina Ross, a trichologist in Atlanta, with a patient at her functional medicine clinic

sections.label: If this sounds familiar

headings.text: You have been to doctors. You still do not feel heard.

paragraphs: You are not difficult, and you are not imagining it. You have just never been given the time.

sections.label: Meet Dr. Nina

headings.text: The doctor who looks closer and listens longer.

paragraphs: For years I watched people, so many of them women who looked like me, carry symptoms that no one would slow down to explain. So I built the practice I wished they could walk into. One where you are believed first, investigated thoroughly, and treated as a whole person with a life, not a fifteen minute slot.
When someone finally feels seen, the healing has already begun.

sections.label: Why hair is a signal

headings.text: Hair loss is rarely just about your hair.

paragraphs: Most hair loss is downstream of something systemic, your thyroid, your iron, your hormones, your stress. Treating the scalp alone misses it. As a trichologist and functional medicine doctor, I read the whole picture and treat what is actually driving the shedding.
Your hair is telling the truth about your health. We listen to it.

This is medicine that respects both your science and your story.
